is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes (An. arabiensis, An. gambiae s.s., An. merus) in Zanzibar.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports insecticide susceptibility bioassays (WHO tube tests) and net efficacy tests, but does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS or allele frequencies) are reported. The paper only reports species identification via PCR.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Zanzibar (Pemba and Unguja islands, Tanzania).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data on insecticide resistance and net durability.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites in the West district of Unguja and North Pemba.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collection periods in 2010 and 2011.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes original field collections conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data for the study's conclusions are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study assesses the susceptibility of Anopheles mosquitoes to insecticides and the durability of LLINs in Zanzibar. While it reports bioassay results and species identification, it does not perform or report any genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers.
